holdDeltas.diagnosis: Local person p003 Emperor Yizong is grounded only in an English title-reference on s0002. Primary Chinese is 父逢，咸通中為秘書監，以才名著於時: it names father Feng and reign period 咸通中, not 懿宗 or any Han sovereign title. The idiomatic English translation inserts “under Emperor Yizong,” which editorializes reign context into a certifiable ruler record. Anchor 懿宗 elsewhere does not justify a chapter-local Chinese witness for this attributed membership.
